scope: Offline, read-only exact BIOS 1.06 and CH551 EC 1.01 inspection; no device access or updater execution
conclusion: The reviewed BIOS/EC do not yet establish a keyboard-effect getter or embedded keyboard-MCU payload. EC firmware does contain a real Razer USB command implementation, but its reviewed descriptor is 1532:F003; its class 03 branch echoes the staged report with success status without reading lighting state. This cannot supply independent readback for the admitted keyboard 1532:0253.

bios.extraction: 83 raw/freeform or relevant ACPI/EC FFS GUIDs, 231 extracted section binaries; full UEFI report retained. Initial recursive extraction exceeded Windows path length, so selected FFS bodies were extracted into flat GUID-numbered folders.
bios.ec_access: DSDT lines 62244-62375: SystemIO 0x300/0x301 mailbox and 0x302/0x303 secondary pair; BMCR/BMRD/BMWD, RECR/RECW indirect EC operations. No established lighting effect/color state semantics.

razer_acpi_module.analysis: RazerAcpiDxe.c: function 0x14C0 initialization reads EC mailbox and transfers bounded data into allocated ACPI/NVS-related storage. No keyboard-lighting effect command or independent getter established.

bios.update_components: FlashAFUWin.bat calls AFU on Charlotte5_0106.bin and FWUpdLcl on Charlotte5_0106_FWU.bin; latter is separate Intel ME update. No keyboard-MCU updater target identified in reviewed package metadata/script.

ec.architecture: Andes NDS32, little-endian data, big-endian instruction encoding; base/file offset zero; GP set to 0x80000 at 0x3002/0x3006

report_ingress.set_path: 0x6F6C-0x6F9C: Feature report length >=90, copy 90 bytes to GP+0x1410, mark GP+0x1326 pending, call 0xF7E8
report_ingress.get_path: 0x6F06-0x6F44: return 90 bytes from same GP+0x1410 buffer; while busy returns error

dispatch.class_03: 0xF850, no command-specific handler; preassigned status 2 is preserved, checksum recomputed and pending cleared
dispatch.implication: 03/0A, 03/8A, 03/83 etc on this reviewed EC route have no effect-state load/store established; success-looking response would be staged request echo, not independent lighting readback

ec.indicator_string: 0x267C0 keyboard led ,usb_Indicators=%d is consumed by ordinary one-byte HID OUTPUT report at 0x6F54-0x6F66, not evidence of RGB effect state.
ec.mailbox: 0x2198 dispatches mapped A0/A1 at 0x2374 onwards; generic peripheral transfers from 0x22B8->0x56E0 and 0x22D4->0x5500 exist but exact keyboard downstream identity/address/lighting schema is not established.
ec.payload_scan: No validated embedded keyboard MCU image identified; heuristic found no plausible aligned Cortex-M vector table in EC. This is architecture-specific screening, not proof of payload absence.

hid_report_descriptor.boundary: A raw 90-byte firmware control handler does not establish the Windows 91-byte keyboard HID feature descriptor.

local_controller_ownership.meaning: Local EC USB controller, not an established keyboard 0253 endpoint

limitations: Descriptor/source review does not prove current live enumeration, bytes or keyboard controller wiring.
User diagnostic reports EC1.00, whereas inspected released image is EC1.01; BIOS1.06 metadata is not image attestation.
Selected raw/freeform sections and ACPI tables were inspected, not every machine instruction or every possible packed/encrypted payload. Dynamic ACPI data transfer exists in RazerAcpiDxe.
No exact 1532:0253 effect/color readback consumer or keyboard-MCU bridge contract has been found in this bounded review.
Do not infer that a missing standalone MCU download makes full keyboard support impossible; missing exact getter/target evidence remains the concrete gap.
independentReview: Separate source review confirmed the consumed 1532:F003 descriptor, descriptor geometry, class03 echo path, class0F rejection and local EC USB ownership. No hardware access.
